title: Suresh Singh v. Managing Director, Kanpur Electricity Supply Co. Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J. and Vipin Sinha, J.
disposition: Assessment set aside; EE to consider objection and decide afresh.
headnote: When a consumer objects to a provisional assessment, the Executive Engineer must apply his mind to the objection before finalizing the assessment under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. A mechanical proforma order that merely fills figures and does not consider the objection cannot be sustained. The 4 May 2013 assessment against Suresh Singh was set aside; the Executive Engineer was directed to consider the objection and decide the final assessment within four weeks.
facts: On an inspection dated 4 March 2013, Kanpur Electricity Supply Company issued a provisional assessment notice dated 16 March 2013 to the petitioner, Suresh Singh. He filed a detailed objection dated 16 April 2013 before the Executive Engineer. By order dated 4 May 2013 the Executive Engineer finalized the assessment on a printed proforma by filling in figures. The order acknowledged receipt of the objection but did not consider it. Singh sought a writ quashing that final assessment.

reusable_constructions.construction: When an objection is filed to a provisional assessment, the assessing officer must apply his mind to and consider that objection before finalizing the assessment.
A final assessment passed on a printed proforma by merely filling figures, without considering the consumer's objection, is a mechanical order without application of mind and cannot be sustained.

holding_units.topic: consideration of objection before final assessment
holding_units.holding: When an objection is filed to a provisional assessment, the Executive Engineer is obliged to apply his mind to and consider that objection before finalizing the assessment. An assessment finalized on a printed proforma by merely filling figures, which acknowledges receipt of the objection but does not consider it, is a mechanical order without application of mind and cannot be sustained under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 mechanism for finalizing assessment. The 4 May 2013 assessment is set aside and the Executive Engineer is directed to consider the objection and decide the final assessment within four weeks of production of the order.
holding_units.flag: judgment invokes the 2005 Code mechanism for finalizing assessment without citing a clause number

not_decided.point: merits and quantum of the final assessment
not_decided.note: The assessment was set aside only for non-consideration of the objection; the Executive Engineer was directed to decide afresh.
